versions.changelog: Notes that this is the roundtable core of Solo OS; pins the Chinese names of the four tables (角色桌 / 盲桌 / 真人桌 / 反调桌) so Chinese sessions use them consistently.

Roundtable repositioned as an option-shaping session: 2-3 candidates, one recommendation, and the evidence each still lacks; the vote shows lean, not a verdict. Sub-modes renamed to four tables (role / blind / human / contrarian), legacy codes 1a-1d noted.
Restore display name; no content change.
Add the outside seat: a blind answer from another vendor's model, no vote; anonymized results from 26 runs.
Metadata only: set topics (ai-workflow,roundtable,decision-making); categories unchanged. No content change.
Metadata only: set categories (Productivity, Agents). No content change.

Full English rewrite. Same framework, same four anonymized case studies (the null-option collapse, the unanimous reinvention of existing definitions, the vote that overturned a standing decision, the tenfold-cheaper DIY rewrite) - only the language changed.
首次发布：从一套运转半年以上、沉淀三百余份决策记录的私有协作系统中提炼的通用框架——专家圆桌协议（已决议扫描／事实验证／票比按证据拆分三个检查点）、角色三维度生成、四种认知多样性子模式、落盘门槛与四层知识免疫模型，附四个匿名化真实案例。
